mentions.name: Next-gen LLM harness
mentions.description: A next-generation LLM harness with a demonstrator implementing roughly 40% of its complete specifications, built on top of mono pi. Running state-of-the-art frontier models through its components produces large differences in overall reasoning and reliability, and early users report the models feel cozier, more reliable, and have slightly more reasoning capacity.
mentions.source_excerpt: the main thing ive been hacking on recently is what i consider to be the first next gen llm harness, ive a demonstrator that implements like 40percent of what ive pretty complete specs for on top of mono pi.  theres some pretty big differences in overall reasoning and reliability when i run most useful sota frontier models with all my pieces.  early users have reported the models actually are more cozy, reliable and have a teeny bit more reasoning capacity
